summary: City page + 2024 park map read: 6 first-come sites with electric (amps not posted) and water, $20 ($120/week), 7-night max, May - Oct 1. Stored pin is in Mondovi's millpond 1.5 km north: move to the sites at ~44.5568,-91.6672. Riverfront -> not waterfront (Buffalo River ~600 m north).
flags: PIN MOVE ~1.48 km: stored 44.5700,-91.6690 sits in the water of Mondovi's millpond (Mirror Lake) north of downtown. Tourist Park is on County Road H at the south edge of town (Google 44.5567,-91.6685 = the park entrance/shelter); on imagery the loop matches the city map and campsites 1-6 (RVs visible) are at its east end, ~44.5568,-91.6672.

WATERFRONT DOWNGRADE riverfront -> not waterfront (stored value from the June 2026 sweep, not --AWH): at the true location the Buffalo River is ~600 m north across fields and woods; no water is near any of sites 1-6. The stored 'riverfront' and the note's 'near the Buffalo River' likely came from the wrong pin.
HOOKUPS: electric at every site per the page and map; amperage not posted, so hookups.electric is not written.
DUMP: not stated. The park map carries directions to the Mondovi Wastewater Treatment Plant, which may be where campers dump - the page does not say so; not written.
